sloka: एवम् वदन्तः ते सोढुम् न शेकुर् बाष्पम् आगतम् ।अथ राजा वृतः स्त्रीभिर् दीनाभिर् दीन चेतनः ॥२-४०-२७॥
transliteration: evam vadantaḥ te soḍhum na śekur bāṣpam āgatam ।atha rājā vṛtaḥ strībhir dīnābhir dīna cetanaḥ ॥2-40-27॥

translations.english: Speaking thus, the people following their beloved Rama, the delight of the Ikshvaku dynasty, were not able to bear (restrain) the tears flowing from their eyes.
